_comment: WIMP-nucleon SI, DAMIC-M projection, 1x1 channel only, 1.3 kg-day exposure (mass_kg=1.0, livetime_days=1.3) -- an LBC-exposure-matched counterpart to wimp_damicm_projection_floor60_1kgyear.json (same config, only livetime_days differs), so the two can be plotted together as a near-term-vs-eventual sensitivity comparison, the same way the other channels pair an LBC-exposure config with a 1 kg-year projection. Diffusion/noise/halo are DAMIC-M values sourced ONLY from pydme + this repo's own existing defaults (see configs/wimp_nucleon_generate_si_damicm_halo.json's _comment for exact provenance) -- NOT from the (excluded) DamicMSignal-main repo. Background model (flat rate 5478.75 events/(kg*yr*keV) + Fig.9-digitized 1x1 background efficiency curve) is REUSED AS-IS from the DAMIC 2016 SNOLAB reproduction (configs/wimp_nucleon_damic2016_limit_repro.json) per explicit instruction -- DAMIC-M has no background model of its own here yet; this is a placeholder, not a DAMIC-M measurement. Etrue_min_eV: DAMIC 2016's own 60 eV floor, carried over unchanged -- a known simplification that understates DAMIC-M's real low-mass reach given its ~11x lower noise (0.16 vs 1.8 e-); kept as a controlled baseline against the scaled-floor variant. Sigma grid extended to 1e-45 (50 pts) -- the original 1e-42 lower bound left the true crossing unresolved near the grid edge for this much more sensitive projection.
_header: Diego Venegas-Vargas | DAMIC-M collaboration | CCDarkSens Framework -- Student example: WIMP-nucleon SI, DAMIC-M projection, 1x1 channel, 1.3 kg-day (LBC-exposure-matched) case, DAMIC 2016's own 60 eV true-energy floor carried over unchanged (floor60 variant). Background is DAMIC 2016's own, reused as a placeholder -- DAMIC-M has no background model of its own yet.
